mapper.sql: a.id, a.light_id, a.alarm_config_id, a.voice_template_id, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks
LEFT JOIN swm_alarm_config b ON b.id = a.alarm_config_id AND b.status = '0' LEFT JOIN swm_voice_template c ON c.id = a.voice_template_id AND c.status = '0'
mapper.select:

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO swm_alarm_light_config( id, light_id, alarm_config_id, voice_template_id, status, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, remarks ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lightId}, #{alarmConfigId}, #{voiceTemplateId}, #{status}, #{createBy.id}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy.id}, #{updateDate}, #{remarks} )
mapper.update: UPDATE swm_alarm_light_config SET alarm_config_id = #{alarmConfigId}, voice_template_id = #{voiceTemplateId}, update_by = #{updateBy.id}, update_date = #{updateDate}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE swm_alarm_light_config SET status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = NOW() WHERE light_id = #{lightId}
